schema.attachmentsByLocation: [locationIndex] -> attachmentIndex[], ordered by gap, connector, id; no candidates discarded
schema.insideIntervalsM: positive interior intervals measured from split-edge from-node along its 3D centreline, in metres

geographicSemantics: Interior overlap applies only to the referenced split edge and intervals. Bypasses means a nearby outside segment, not a complete alternate journey or control.
coordinateSemantics: Positions in metres; road departure ASL is source-derived, anchor ASL is projected/approximate. Footprint approach is XY only; elevation and vehicle traversal remain unassessed.
policy: Attachments are endpoints only; locations never provide transit links. Off-road gaps remain unassessed.
